Interface ClassDefinition

All Known Subinterfaces:
JmodelClassDefinition
All Known Implementing Classes:
CommonModel, JSimGraphModel, JSIMModel
public interface ClassDefinition
Created by IntelliJ IDEA. User: OrsotronIII Date: 23-mag-2005 Time: 9.34.34 This interface provides methods for editation of model's classes details. In the implementing class of this interface, model's userclasses must be accessed through a research key that must be represented by a number. This gives possibility of a smarter implementation for search and editing methods than a name-based search modality. Modified by Francesco D'Aquino 21/11/2005

      Object addClass(String name, int type, Integer priority, Double softDeadline, Integer population, Object distribution)
      Adds a new class to the model and sets all class parameters at once.
      Parameters:
      name - name of the new class.
      type - type of the new class.
      priority - priority of the new class.
      softDeadline - soft deadline of the new class.
      population - population of the new class.
      distribution - inter-arrival time distribution of the new class.
